versions.content: On reception of an UDS Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22) re- quest with one or more availability OBDInfoTypeDataIdentifier as parameter, the Dcm module shall respond with the corresponding supported (=configured) DID s in the OBD range (F800-F8FF).
